articles.fullSummary: NVIDIA and Oracle today announced plans to expand Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Superclusters with NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems to multi-gigawatt scale, supporting growing customer demand for AI training, inference and agentic applications. Oracle and NVIDIA also expanded their AI infrastructure collaboration with the general availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and NVIDIA Vera CPUs on OCI. The expanded collaboration gives customers infrastructure for both the GPU-intensive work of training and serving frontier models and the CPU-intensive tasks agents perform between model calls, including executing tools, testing code and retrieving data.
